paper.title: A Multi-Functional Synthetic Gene Network: A Frequency Multiplier, Oscillator and Switch

code.archive: ReScience C 8.1 (#5), 2022 replication article; the code is the replication's own repo, not the 2011 authors' MATLAB code (the 2011 paper states none is archived)
code.note: Commit is HEAD as returned by git ls-remote at 2026-11-26 12:24Z. The rerun mind must check out this exact SHA. The replication repo is CC-BY-4.0 and contains experiments.py, src/parameters/*.mat.

field: computational biology (synthetic gene networks, bifurcation analysis)
stack: Octave 5.2.0 / 6.2.0 with Octave Forge signal 1.4.1 and control 3.2.0; python3 for the driver (experiments.py); the 2011 original used MATLAB, MAPLE and AUTO for continuation (not reproduced in this repo, to be checked)

claim.location: Figure 5 caption and text (Results, Bifurcation structure): the Hopf bifurcation of equilibrium c1, input concentration of the sketch in Figure 5
claim.paper_value: I ~ 7 nM (approximately 7 nM); the caption says 'These occur at input concentrations of ~0.4 nM, ~7 nM and ~9 nM respectively' for the two saddle-node, Hopf and pitchfork bifurcations. Scout registers only the Hopf value.
claim.value_check: Read verbatim from page 6 of the PLOS PDF (file saved from journals.plos.org printable URL, Figure 5 caption) and the text 'a pitchfork bifurcation at I ~9 nM' on page 5 (Bifurcation structure paragraph). Both checked by scout by reading the rendered page.
claim.metric: input concentration I (nM) at which the Hopf bifurcation of the model occurs, using the parameters of the paper's Table 1 (which the replication stores in src/parameters/network.mat, to be checked by the rerun mind)

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run: the paper gives a value of about 7 nM (an approximation to one significant figure). Pass if the rerun Hopf input is within 0.5 nM of 7 nM, i.e. 6.5 to 7.5 nM. Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: About 14 minutes for all experiments on a modest laptop (the replication README says so; about 10 minutes of that is the Figure 8 experiment). The Hopf check is a subset; the rerun mind should time the single experiment.
cost.data_size: Small: parameter .mat files in src/parameters/. Sizes not shown in the repo README; the rerun mind must check. No external dataset download.
cost.data_licence: Repo is CC-BY-4.0 (per the replication README). No external data.

why: A 2011 synthetic-biology ODE model with a pre-registered bifurcation value, replicated in Octave (MATLAB-to-Octave long-tail stack) with a small public repo and about 14 CPU minutes for the full set.
